description: This is a Java class named JavaMailContainer that implements email retrieval and processing through JavaMail API within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages email store connections, polls for new messages, processes unread emails, optionally deletes them, and triggers business rules based on email content.

classes.name: JavaMailContainer
classes.description: A container class for managing email fetching, processing, and rule evaluation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the JavaMailContainer with configuration, command list, and name.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container: loads configuration, initializes email stores, setups scheduled polling, and loads user login.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the polling executor service.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a JavaMail Session object from provided configuration properties.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Establishes and returns a mail Store connection based on the session.

methods.name: updateUrlName
methods.description: Constructs a URLName with credentials and host info, possibly overriding with properties.
